paragraphs.text: Appointments with a doctor can be booked online, by phone or at reception. Phone lines open at 8 am, and most same-day appointments are taken within the first hour, so we recommend using the online system if possible.
Routine appointments last ten minutes and can be booked up to four weeks in advance. If you have more than one problem to discuss, please book a double appointment.
For repeat prescriptions, please allow two working days. Prescriptions can be ordered online or by leaving the request form in the box by the main door; we do not take prescription requests by phone.
Our nurses can see you for blood tests, vaccinations and dressings. Blood tests are only available before 11 am, as samples must reach the hospital laboratory the same day.

If you need medical help urgently when the centre is closed, call the out-of-hours number shown on our website. Please do not come to the centre without an appointment unless a member of staff has asked you to.

items.quote: most same-day appointments are taken within the first hour, so we recommend using the online system
items.prompt: Why does the centre recommend booking online?

options.text: Same-day appointments by phone go quickly.

explanation.en: “most same-day appointments are taken within the first hour, so we recommend using the online system” → B. Price (A) and length (D) are not linked to booking online.
explanation.kk: «most same-day appointments are taken within the first hour, so we recommend using the online system» → B. Баға (A) мен ұзақтық (D) онлайн тіркелуге қатысты айтылмайды.
explanation.ru: «most same-day appointments are taken within the first hour, so we recommend using the online system» → B. Цены (A) и длительность (D) здесь не связаны с записью онлайн.

items.quote: If you have more than one problem to discuss, please book a double appointment
items.prompt: Patients who want to discuss two problems should

explanation.en: “If you have more than one problem to discuss, please book a double appointment” → C. B sounds logical, but the centre advises otherwise.
explanation.kk: «If you have more than one problem to discuss, please book a double appointment» → C. B қисынды естіледі, бірақ орталық басқа жолды ұсынады.
explanation.ru: «If you have more than one problem to discuss, please book a double appointment» → C. B звучит логично, но центр советует другое.

items.quote: by leaving the request form in the box by the main door
items.prompt: One way to order a repeat prescription is by

options.text: leaving a form in the box by the main door.

explanation.en: “by leaving the request form in the box by the main door” → D. A is ruled out: “we do not take prescription requests by phone”.
explanation.kk: «by leaving the request form in the box by the main door» → D. A-ға тікелей тыйым салынған: «we do not take prescription requests by phone».
explanation.ru: «by leaving the request form in the box by the main door» → D. A прямо запрещено: «we do not take prescription requests by phone».

items.quote: samples must reach the hospital laboratory the same day
items.prompt: Blood tests must be done before 11 am because

options.text: the nurses finish work at that time.
samples must reach the hospital the same day.
patients must not eat before a test.
the laboratory is closed in the afternoon.

explanation.en: “as samples must reach the hospital laboratory the same day” → B. D sounds plausible, but the laboratory’s hours are not mentioned.
explanation.kk: «as samples must reach the hospital laboratory the same day» → B. D сенімді естіледі, бірақ зертхананың жұмыс уақыты мәтінде айтылмайды.
explanation.ru: «as samples must reach the hospital laboratory the same day» → B. D правдоподобен, но о режиме лаборатории текст не говорит.

items.quote: call the out-of-hours number shown on our website
items.prompt: If the centre is closed and you need urgent medical help, you should

options.text: wait until the phone lines open.
call the number shown on the website.

explanation.en: “call the out-of-hours number shown on our website” → C. The website also appears in paragraph 1, but that is about booking, not urgent help (D).
explanation.kk: «call the out-of-hours number shown on our website» → C. Сайт 1-абзацта да аталады, бірақ онда шұғыл көмек емес, қабылдауға тіркелу туралы айтылған (D).
explanation.ru: «call the out-of-hours number shown on our website» → C. Сайт упоминается и в абзаце 1, но там речь о записи, а не о срочной помощи (D).
